intro: MercuryMap's travelers are drawn to coastal cities, with waterfront character showing up from Lisbon and Venice to Sydney and Cape Town.

suggestions.reason: Porto extends the Atlantic waterfront appeal already visible in the community's Lisbon photos.
Its Mediterranean beaches and lively city center fit the community's mix of urban and seaside stops.
Cartagena adds a Caribbean waterfront to the same historic-coastal spirit seen in Venice and Cape Town.
